newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals subdued despite cuts by state firm.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals subdued despite cuts by state firm.

text.p: Indian metals prices were mixed on subdued sentiment on Monday despite state firm Hindustan Copper Ltd cutting its selling prices, dealers said.
Nickel prices extended gains but other base metals were unchanged.
Hindustan Copper cut selling prices of copper wire bar by 12,000 to 106,000 rupees per quintal for September, one dealer said. Hindustan Zinc prices were unchanged.
Nickel rose by 400 rupees to 39,900 rupees on a shortage of ready stock, thin supplies and fresh physical support.
It was up by 300 rupees on Saturday.
